description: 3D Disaster Potential Map (3D災害潛勢地圖), NCDR is a geoportal run by National Science and Technology Center for Disaster Reduction (NCDR), Taiwan. The viewer shows flood, debris-flow, landslide, earthquake and tsunami potential layers on a three-dimensional map of Taiwan and links to the underlying disaster-potential data of the national disaster-reduction centre. Coverage: Taiwan. It is reached online through the home page and its search, download or service pages, in forms such as viewer, wms; access is free of charge and open to view; downloads may need a free account. The licence is: terms set by the site, not read in this search. Caveats: the home page was opened on 2026-09-30 and only its title ("3D災害潛勢地圖") was read, so the holdings, the current terms and the availability of downloads were not browsed, and this description rests on the agency's publicly documented role and may lag the site. It can support hazard exposure screening for infrastructure in Taiwan. Related records: no directly related record is catalogued yet.
